title: दो अक्षर के शब्द (Do Akshar ke Shabd – Two-Letter Words)

sections.heading: Every consonant has a built-in "a" sound: क = ka, ल = la. Put two together and you get a word: क + ल = कल (kal). In Hindi, the last "a" is silent, so we say kal, not kala.
